verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows Riveter exposing itself as an MCP server for external AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) to connect to and use Riveter's own tools (riveter-docs-9, riveter-docs-20) — this is the reverse direction of the story. There is no evidence that Riveter itself can consume or plug in third-party MCP servers to gain their tools within its own enrichment/agent loops.
